subject: FFmpeg current-host closure portability and production-evidence correction
reason: The prior current-host validator used Dell T7910, Xeon E5-2696 v4 and exact 2-package/44-core/88-thread/2-NUMA facts as PASS conditions.

FA3-HARDWARE-BASELINE-001 and FA3-HARDWARE-DISCOVERY-CONTRACTS-001 require live discovery and explicitly forbid reference-host machine, CPU model and fixed topology tuples as portable production admission identity.
The prior FFmpeg closure also used a provider-local HRB receipt schema instead of the already materialized canonical AcceleratorExecutionLease@1 execution pattern.
The prior production closure could be satisfied with synthetic media, which was weaker than the canonical real-media E2E requirement.
